items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1963-03-29
items.q: he used to play at the Ricca Band until he died, Ferret.

ctx.x: I'll get back in the background. Big Eddie Jackson on that Sousa horn. That was my favorite Sousa horn player. Big Eddie Jackson, Old Man Kimball too. Old Man Kimball played nice Sousa horn too. Eddie Jackson, Old Man Kimball, and I remember another good Sousa horn player. His name used to live on Simon Bob. Correct. No. Page. No. No, very not. He'd play clarinet, that's when I was playing Riddles Tuxedo. John Porter. John Porter. John Porter. And this other fella played good Sousa horn too which was a tremor…
of the desert. And this fella, he used to play at the Ricca Band until he died, Ferret. Ferret. You remember that? Ferret, yeah. He used to wear the apron. Yeah. He was pretty good. Yeah.

And your snare drummers. Well, one of the snare drummers, I used to like Alfred. You're talking back in the old and old. Well, yeah, I used to like Alfred and I was stuff I don't remember if he was a good snare drum player. And this fellow used to play a snare drum with the Eureka Brass Band a long time ago. Well, there were two good drummers there, a good snare drum player, Evo Wells used to play with the Golden Ghost Brass Band, he was a good snare drum player as well. You said Alfred, who he was? Alfred…
